mir.text: Jolrael is a recluse who, scorned by her peers, forsakes humanity and goes alone into the Mwonvuli, and she has hidden from the machinations of Zhalfir for centuries.
She meets Mangara and Kaervek on Teferi's phased-out isle, and Kaervek allies with her, persuading her that Mangara means to conquer the continent.
Manipulated by Kaervek, Jolrael declares war on Mangara, and the two ambush him and imprison him in an Amber Prison.
When she realizes the truth she attacks Kaervek at sea, and after Teferi sinks Kaervek's armada and sends a drake to rescue her, she retreats to the Mwonvuli.

vis.text: Jolrael foresees that she will betray Kaervek or Jamuraa, seeing the horrors Kaervek has freed.
Teferi's isle returns and he slays one of her dragons, and when she seeks his help he refuses to intercede and offers dreams and visions instead.
When Kaervek sails to Teferi's Isle, Teferi destroys his armada and Jolrael turns on him.

j21.text: Jolrael, called the empress of beasts, speaks of Dominaria's system of life with its prey and predators.
